scripts.{{ .ServiceName }}-cli:
#!/bin/sh
REDISCLI_AUTH="$(cat "${{ upper .ServiceName }}_PASSWORD_FILE")" exec redli -h "${{ upper .ServiceName }}_HOST" -p "${{ upper .ServiceName }}_PORT" -n "${{ upper .ServiceName }}_DATABASE" --user "${{ upper .ServiceName }}_USER" "$@"

dataVolume.name: {{ .AppName }}-{{ .ServiceName }}-data
dataVolume.description: Redis data directory (optional, for RDB/AOF persistence)
